# Test fixtures

Every fixture used by the tests, with its source and licence.

## Synthetic (generated in code, no third-party content)

Built at test time by `tests/helpers/images.ts`, so no binary is committed:

| Fixture (plan name) | Builder | What it contains |
|---|---|---|
| `gps.jpg` | `buildGpsJpeg()` | Baseline JPEG (jpeg-js) + APP0 JFIF, APP1 Exif (Make `NoploadCam`, Model, Orientation 6, Software, DateTimeOriginal, GPS 52.37 N / 4.89 E), APP1 XMP, APP2 ICC, APP13 IPTC, COM |
| `photo.png` | `buildMetaPng()` | RGB PNG + iCCP, tEXt, iTXt, zTXt, eXIf, tRNS, tIME |
| `photo.webp` | `buildMetaWebp()` | RIFF/WEBP structure: VP8X (alpha + EXIF + XMP flags), VP8L, odd-length EXIF, XMP |
| `transparent.png` | `makePng(w, h, { transparent: true })` | RGBA PNG with a fully transparent border |
| `large-12mp.jpg` | `makeJpeg(4000, 3000)` | 12 MP gradient + noise JPEG |
| compress batch | `makeJpeg` / `makePng` | 15 JPEG (q100) + 15 PNG, 320x240 |

Licence: written for this repo (© Arpan Mandal).

## Real files (to be added by the owning workstream)

| File | Owner | Required properties | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `portrait.jpg` | WS2 | A person on a distinct background | [File:Portrait_with_black_hair,_3080644.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_with_black_hair,_3080644.jpg) by himanshugunarathna ([Pixabay 3080644](https://pixabay.com/en/fashion-woman-portrait-model-3080644/)). Resized to 1600 px wide, cropped at x >= 300, then padded on the right with a mirrored copy of the left 340 px background strip so all four 10% corners are background (1640x1000). | CC0 1.0 |
| `portrait.mask.json` | WS2 | `{"subject": {"x", "y", "w", "h"}}`: a hand-marked box fully inside the subject, in `portrait.jpg` pixels | hand-made: the cheeks and nose, below the eyes | © Arpan Mandal |
| `product.jpg` | WS2 | A product / object photo | [File:Cup of tea isolated on white background - Petr Kratochvil.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cup_of_tea_isolated_on_white_background_-_Petr_Kratochvil.jpg) by Petr Kratochvil (publicdomainpictures.net image 4291), resized to 1280x853 | CC0 1.0 |
| `sample.heic` | WS3 | A redistributable HEIC (or one generated with a permissively licensed encoder, documented here) | Generated by us: a synthetic 640x480 gradient with a circle and a square, encoded with [pillow-heif](https://github.com/bigcat88/pillow_heif) (BSD-3-Clause, libheif LGPL, x265 encoder) via `Image.save(..., quality=70)`. No third-party image content. | � Arpan Mandal (own work, no third-party content) |
| `sample.heic.json` | WS3 | `{"width", "height"}` of `sample.heic` after orientation | hand-made | © Arpan Mandal |

The e2e specs fail with `fixture tests/fixtures/<name> is missing (added by <owner>…)` until these exist.
